name: CES 5277 襟翼卡阻 无法完全放下

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CES 277, you are parking at gate 213, you have received information M, request ATC clearance to London Heathrow from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CES 277，停在 213 号登机口，已收到通播 M，向武汉放行请求飞往伦敦希思罗的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES 5277, gate 213, information M, request ATC clearance to London Heathrow.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES 5277，213 号登机口，通播 M，请求飞往伦敦希思罗的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: CES 277, cleared to London Heathrow via flight planned route, departure Runway 04, initial climb 2700 meters, LKO-02 departure, cruising level 8400 meters, squawk 2512.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 277，许可飞往伦敦希思罗，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 04，起始爬升 2700 米，LKO-02 离场，巡航高度 8400 米，应答机 2512。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to London Heathrow via flight planned route, departure Runway 04, initial climb 2700 meters, LKO-02 departure, cruising level 8400 meters, squawk 2512, CES 5277.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往伦敦希思罗，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 04，起始爬升 2700 米，LKO-02 离场，巡航高度 8400 米，应答机 2512，CES 5277。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好滑行，联系武汉地面。

cards.audioText: C: CES 277, taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway A4, E2, hold short of Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 277，经滑行道 A4、E2 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，跑道 36R 外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway A4, E2, hold short of Runway 36R, CES 5277.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 A4、E2 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，跑道 36R 外等待，CES 5277。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding short of Runway 36R, contact the controller to request cross the Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36R 外等待，联系管制员请求穿越跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 5277, holding short of Runway 36R, request cross the Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 5277，跑道 36R 外等待，请求穿越跑道 36R。

cards.audioText: C: CES 277, expedite cross Runway 36R, report vacated.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 277，快速穿越跑道 36R，报告脱离。
cards.referenceText: Expedite cross Runway 36R, report vacated, CES 5277.
cards.referenceTextZh: 快速穿越跑道 36R，报告脱离，CES 5277。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have exited Runway 36R, report it to Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已脱离跑道 36R，向武汉塔台报告。
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 5277，跑道 36R 已脱离。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding short of Runway 04, you are ready for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 04 外等待，准备好离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 5277, holding short of Runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 5277，跑道 04 外等待，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: CES 277, after departure, climb straight ahead until 600 meters, follow SID, direct to LKO, contact Wuhan Departure 120.2, cleared for takeoff Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 277，离场后直线爬升至 600 米，执行 SID，直飞 LKO，联系武汉离场 120.2，跑道 04 可以起飞。
cards.referenceText: After departure, climb straight ahead until 600 meters, follow SID, direct to LKO, contact Wuhan Departure 120.2, cleared for takeoff Runway 04, CES 5277.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离场后直线爬升至 600 米，执行 SID，直飞 LKO，联系武汉离场 120.2，跑道 04 可以起飞，CES 5277。

cards.audioText: B: After takeoff, your flaps seem to be jammed, report the situation to Wuhan Approach and request hold for further check.
cards.audioTextZh: B：起飞后，你的襟翼似乎卡住，向武汉进近报告情况并请求等待以进一步检查。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 5277, our flaps seem to be jammed, request hold for further check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 5277，我们的襟翼似乎卡住，请求等待以进一步检查。

cards.audioText: C: CES 277, roger, turn right, direct to LKO, hold at LKO VOR 210 radio, hold at 3300 meters, inbound track 280 degrees, left hand pattern, outbound time 1 minute.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 277，收到，右转，直飞 LKO，在 LKO VOR 210 径向等待，等待高度 3300 米，入航航迹 280 度，左等待，出航时间 1 分钟。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to LKO, hold at LKO VOR 210 radio, hold at 3300 meters, inbound track 280 degrees, left hand pattern, outbound time 1 minute, CES 5277.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 LKO，在 LKO VOR 210 径向等待，等待高度 3300 米，入航航迹 280 度，左等待，出航时间 1 分钟，CES 5277。

cards.audioText: B: After performing the checklist, the flap problem can't be solved, report it to Wuhan Approach and request return to land.
cards.audioTextZh: B：完成检查单后，襟翼问题无法解决，向武汉进近报告并请求返回着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 5277, the flap problem can't be solved, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 5277，襟翼问题无法解决，请求返回着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CES 277, turn right heading 340, follow LKO-03A arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 277，右转航向 340，执行 LKO-03A 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 04。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 340, follow LKO-03A arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 04, CES 5277.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 340，执行 LKO-03A 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 04，CES 5277。

cards.audioText: B: You can't fully extend the flaps, tell Wuhan Tower that you need to land on the longest runway.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你无法完全放出襟翼，告诉武汉塔台你需要在最长跑道上着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 5277, we can't fully extend the flaps, request the longest runway for landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 5277，我们无法完全放出襟翼，请求最长跑道着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CES 277, turn right heading 030 to join right hand downwind Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 277，右转航向 030，加入跑道 04 右三边。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 030 to join right hand downwind Runway 04, CES 5277.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 030，加入跑道 04 右三边，CES 5277。

cards.audioText: C: CES 277, cleared to land, Runway 04.
